basis: frozen (AI-reviewed baseline), reviewed by ChatGPT (GPT-6, AI reviewer), as stated in its review relayed by the repository owner on 2026-11-20

requirements.quote: To test local web applications, write native Python Playwright scripts.
requirements.reason: Stated in Context and the logic generates Playwright scripts.
Help must run before the helper is used (ordering with single and multi too).

requirements.quote: read helper source from scripts as source
requirements.reason: Source read is gated only on help output being insufficient (verify usage), not on a customized solution being absolutely necessary; the 'only when necessary' is in step meaning but the gate differs.

requirements.quote: treat bundled scripts as black boxes and invoke them directly
requirements.reason: Black-box use is present, but there is no step to consider whether a bundled script can do the job before writing custom code; the helper is used only in the not-running-server branch.

requirements.quote:
read html file from target as html
      otherwise:
        return to dynamic
requirements.reason: Static HTML read directly, fallback to dynamic on failure.

requirements.quote: exec #help with_server help from checks as help
requirements.reason: When server is not running, help runs then with_server single/multi is used.

requirements.quote: apply navigate and wait for networkidle before apply inspect rendered state
requirements.reason: Wait precedes inspection in the dynamic path; static path doesn't wait.

requirements.quote: apply inspect rendered state before apply identify selectors
requirements.reason: Inspect, identify, execute ordering is enforced.

requirements.quote: keep automation scripts to Playwright logic only, since with_server manages servers

requirements.reason: Always rule, plus close browser step.

requirements.quote: use descriptive selectors: text=, role=, CSS selectors, or IDs
add appropriate waits with wait_for_selector or wait_for_timeout
